expectations.text: Identifies this as a high-risk, multi-week effort — not a task that can be done in a single sprint
expectations.evidence: Phases Overview table shows '~2 weeks', '~1 week', '~1 week' per phase and 'Total estimated effort: ~18-24 hours of active work spread over 3-5 weeks.' The plan also opens with 'Decision: Apply Expand-Contract Pattern' after listing the risks.

expectations.text: First phase is characterization/learning: understand current payment logic behavior, write tests that capture it, time-boxed
expectations.evidence: Step 1.1 is explicitly 'Learning: Audit all payment-related code and tests (1-2h)' and labeled 'Type: Learning step (time-boxed)'. It catalogs all methods and tests before any code is written.

expectations.text: New PaymentService is built alongside the existing code (expand), not as a replacement from the start
expectations.evidence: Step 1.2: 'Create payment_service.py in the same repository (not a separate repo yet)' and 'OrderService is not changed at all in this step.' Phase 1 is named 'EXPAND — Build PaymentService Alongside OrderService'.

expectations.text: Includes a migration phase with gradual traffic routing (dual-call or feature flag) before decommissioning old code
expectations.evidence: Phase 2 (MIGRATE) uses shadow dual-call throughout Steps 2.1 and 2.2, keeping both old and new logic running simultaneously. Phase 2 Checklist includes 'Rollback plan confirmed: flip feature flag / swap authoritative call'. Old code is only decommissioned in Phase 3 (CONTRACT).

expectations.text: Reads order_service.py to reference actual method names and logic before planning
expectations.evidence: Step 1.1: 'Read order_service.py and identify every method touching payment logic: charge_order, refund_order, _call_payment_gateway, _call_payment_refund' and 'Read test_order_service.py and catalog all tests: test_charge_order_success, test_charge_order_invalid_token, test_charge_already_paid_order, test_refund_order, test_process_order_full_lifecycle'.

expectations.text: Explicitly separates learning steps (investigation, characterization, spike) from earning steps (ship working service)
expectations.evidence: Each step is labeled with 'Type: Learning step (time-boxed)' or 'Type: Earning step'. The Final Self-Check states '[x] Learning steps are separated from earning steps (Step 1.1 is time-boxed research)'.

expectations.text: Each individual step is scoped to 1-3 hours maximum
expectations.evidence: Summary Timeline shows all steps at 1-2h, 2-3h, 1h, or 30min. The Final Self-Check confirms '[x] Every step takes 1-3 hours (no step exceeds this)'.

expectations.text: Does NOT propose a big-bang cutover — does NOT say 'move all payment code to new service and update all callers in one step'
expectations.evidence: The plan uses a 3-phase Expand-Contract pattern over 3-5 weeks. Phase 2 runs old and new logic in parallel via dual-call. Phase 3 only removes old code after 'zero discrepancies in shadow logs for at least 1 week' are confirmed. No step moves all code at once.
